definitions: To remove all coverings or clothes from someone or something.
To remove a component or part from a machine or structure.
To remove paint, varnish, or other coating from a surface.
To deprive someone of property, title, or privilege.
To tear or damage the thread of a screw or bolt.
examples: They decided to strip the old wallpaper.
The mechanic had to strip down the engine.
The company threatened to strip him of his benefits.
Be careful not to strip the screw.
She began to strip the bed linens.
